semiconductor_relevance: High — Hummink's High Precision Capillary Printing technology is directly applicable to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hummink specializes in High Precision Capillary Printing (HPCAP) technology, which is used in the semiconductor and display industries to achieve high-resolution and precise pattern printing. Their flagship product, the NAZCA R&D machine, supports a variety of substrates and inks, offering a comprehensive solution for innovative electronic device manufacturing.
capabilities: NAZCA R&D machine for pattern printing
